description: Research r24 (dev only, step-capped, B200 workers): r22 mal0_st500_ent05_t10_lr2e-6 (r16 + entropy bonus 0.05 on steps after one whose logged entropy was below 0.1) at lr 3e-6. At lr 2e-6, ent05 had no collapse in three seeds (0.360, 0.387, 0.440; 0.405 at step 400) but peaked lower than ent01, which collapsed in 2 of its 8 r22-r23 runs; grad clipping (r23) didn't stop the collapses (no norm spike precedes them). This tests whether the stronger bonus keeps a faster lr stable and lifts the end of the run.
